text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered: PD#87312 — service=canary-inference-usw2, severity=high. Symptom: canary 5xx rate spike (5m error rate 12%, baseline ~0.5%). Affected region: us-west-2. Runbook: https://runbooks/redwood/canary-inference

pagerduty: Routed page to schedule: inference-oncall (Sophie Chen). Escalation policy: after 2m -> platform-oncall.

Sophie Chen: acked. I'm on it. pulling canary metrics and logs now. tagging @Eli Romero @Maya Patel

Eli Romero: I see an increase in model backend 503s coming from node pool gpu-canary-2. CPU/gpu usage looks normal, but connection resets from sidecar.

Maya Patel: Observing a correlated spike in our request latency histogram right before 5xx ramp. QPS stable. Could be a package change in the new canary image.

Sophie Chen: copying logs snippet:
```
2026-03-14T02:05:12Z canary-inference gpu-canary-2 sidecar: upstream_response: code=502 connection_reset
2026-03-14T02:05:13Z canary-inference gpu-canary-2 model-worker: KV cache miss flood, mem-alloc 78% -> OOM retries
2026-03-14T02:05:14Z canary-inference gpu-canary-2 sidecar: 5xx count +48 in 60s
```

Eli Romero: That mem-alloc line is suspicious. New image pushed in this rollout includes a different quantization lib. Might have changed memory allocation pattern.

deploy-bot: Release pipeline: rollout-2026-03-14-177 (canary) -> 30% rolled. Last commit: feat(inference): switch quant-lib to qv2. Commit: a1b2c3d.

Maya Patel: If quant-lib causes higher mem pressure leading to retries, we should fail open the canary traffic or revert. Impact: currently ~12% of inference calls to this region from internal traffic failing, customer-facing traffic routed to us-west-2 for low-latency customers ~3% of total.

Sophie Chen: Proposing mitigation: 1) divert canary traffic to baseline model variant; 2) scale down canary replica group to 0; 3) rollback canary image. I can run the diversion and scale steps now. Anyone object?

Eli Romero: +1 for divert+scale. If rollback takes longer we should divert. Also collect a heap profile from one failing instance (if we can attach).

ops-bot: Action issued: route-traffic --service canary-inference --to baseline-variant --percent 100 --reason "canary 5xx spike"

Sophie Chen: Done — routed canary traffic to baseline variant (confirmation id route-4589). Observed 1 minute after diversion: error rate down to 1.3% in us-west-2.

Maya Patel: Customer impact update: degraded responses peaked ~02:06-02:12 UTC. Estimated affected customer sessions: ~1.8k, error surface: inference failures causing 500s in product. No persistent data loss. Notifying CS to prepare messaging.

Sophie Chen: Scaling canary replica set to 0 and kicking off rollback now: command:
```
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/canary-inference canary-image=redwood/inference:stable-2026-03-09
kubectl -n inference scale deployment canary-inference --replicas=0
```

deploy-bot: Rollback job queued: job-id=rb-2790012367. Expected completion ~90s.

Eli Romero: While rollback runs, please pull the failing pod for a heap/dump and save to /tmp/heap-canary-<pod>.tgz. I'll analyze for mem leak.

Sophie Chen: Pod archived and uploaded to logs bucket: s3://redwood-debug/canary/heap-canary-gpu-canary-2-2790012349.tgz. Link: https://s3.example/redwood-debug/canary/heap-canary-gpu-canary-2-2790012349.tgz

deploy-bot: Rollback completed. Canary replica set scaled to 0, baseline restored. Traffic stable.

Sophie Chen: Confirmed: error rate back to baseline ~0.5% across region. Rolling incident to monitoring. Adding post-incident tasks: (1) block qv2 quant-lib on canary channel until analysis, (2) run memory stress tests in staging, (3) postmortem with root-cause and mitigation timeline.

Alex R.: I'm taking second-oncall handoff for the rest of the window. Summary for handoff:
- What happened: canary rollout with new quant-lib caused memory pressure -> sidecar resets -> 5xx spike.
- Mitigation: diverted canary traffic to baseline variant, scaled canary to 0, rolled back image.
- Customer impact: transient 500s, ~1.8k sessions affected, no data loss.
- Next steps: block new quant-lib, run repro in staging, own postmortem.

Sophie Chen: handing off to @Alex R. All alerts suppressed for 30m. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:

Alex R.: acked. I'll follow up with postmortem owner assignment and CS sync.

incident-bot: Incident closed (brief mitigation). PagerDuty incident PD#87312 auto-resolved after ack and actions.

pagerduty: incident resolved by Sophie Chen at 2026-03-14T02:14:30Z.

Maya Patel: Filing preliminary incident note in #postmortems and assigning owners.

Eli Romero: Saving analysis pointer: potential qv2 allocator regression. tagging infra-research.

Sophie Chen: Thanks all — nice triage and quick mitigation.
